finalists.label: Meningioma
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including CT angiography showing displacement of the prepontine vessels without encasement.

finalists.label: Schwannoma
finalists.why: It has specific for evidence, including Noncontrast CT and MRI findings, with no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: Meningioma is chosen due to its well-circumscribed mass and specific imaging findings, including the displacement of prepontine vessels, which are more decisive than the findings for Schwannoma.
